description: Convert one or more `docker run` commands into a docker-compose.yml (Compose Specification, no obsolete version: key). Handles \ line continuations, quoting, combined short flags (-it, -p8080:80), and several commands (one service each). Maps ports, volumes and --mount (declaring named volumes), env vars, --env-file, restart, networks (as external) and network_mode, healthchecks, resource limits, ulimits, --gpus, logging, labels, capabilities and the command after the image. Returns the YAML, the service names and warnings for flags with no Compose equivalent (like --rm). Parses only; nothing is executed.

command.description: One or more docker run commands, one per line or joined with &&

name: docker_run_to_compose
